description: Default ITempoDocumentService: composes the server-side document pipeline — document assembly (IF/ELSE conditional chains, repeating sections, computed expressions over token values), headless canvas layout (pooled Jint host) and Skia PDF/raster rendering with embedded fonts. The clock is injectable via TimeProvider, so assembly date functions (TODAY/DATEADD) and the forensic watermark timestamp are deterministic under test; a missing forensic timestamp is stamped from the injected clock rather than an uncontrolled UtcNow. RenderPdfAsync returns the PDF plus page count and the layout snapshot JSON it was rendered from; RenderPageImagesAsync rasters every page to PNG at the requested DPI (96 = CSS pixel scale).
